summary: The domain-shift record did not say what was done about a measured shift, and the J9 example fit ignored its measured pt_miss scale shift.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the first release of the ml-artifact domain_shift block

observables: domain_shift record of an ml-artifact (status only, no outcome or nuisance)
J9 example signal strength mu_hat and its interval
impact.bias: a shift that was measured but not corrected or bounded was not visible in the record, and validation accepted it; in J9 the uncorrected shift moved the result: with the shift as a constrained nuisance mu_hat goes from 1.30738 +0.280857/-0.260727 to 1.33104 +0.293293/-0.277051 (seed 20261013, 1000 toys), and the Asimov shift without the nuisance is -0.107539
impact.trigger: an ml-artifact whose domain_shift check found a shift between simulation and control data and whose downstream fit did not carry it as a correction or nuisance

remedy: record domain_shift.outcome and, if the shift is not corrected, carry it as a nuisance in the downstream fit; validate the artifact again with a release that has the fix
